title: Average Pooling 1D Layer
source_docs: Deep Learning Toolbox/Deep Learning Layers/Pooling Layers/Average_Pooling_1D_Layer.md
text: 1-D average pooling layer, 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal; {Layer} sets the corresponding layer object, {Data format} sets the format of input, {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Output integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point output cast operation, {Output saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action for output cast, {Accumulator} sets the data type of accumulator, {Number of pooling elements} sets the data type of standard deviation, {Internal integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for internal fixed-point operations, {Internal saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action for internal block and {Sample time} sets the option to specify sample time. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Layer
params.values: Corresponding layer object layerObject (default) | averagePooling1dLayer object

params.name: Data format
params.values: Format of input data CT (default) | SC

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Data type of output Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Keep MSB | Inherit: Match scaling | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | Inherit: Same as first input |

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Output integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for fixed-point output cast operation Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Output saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action for output cast operation off (default) | on

params.name: Accumulator
params.values: Data type of accumulator Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as first input |

params.name: Number of pooling elements
params.values: Data type of standard deviation Inherit: Inherit via back propagation (default) | Inherit: Inherit from ’Constant value’ |

params.name: Internal integer rounding mode
params.values: Rounding mode for internal fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Internal saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action for internal block operations off (default) | on

params.name: Sample time
params.values: Option to specify sample time -1 (default) | scalar
